limite: Synthetic proposal linked to a local revision of the preparation of selection rules. Sources, formal appointment and authorisation to act remain pending. It does not permit the committee to act or sign minutes.
error_entrada: The committee proposal could not be prepared. Check the references, phases and proposals in the input file.
error_salida: The committee proposal could not be written. Check the output destination and run the preparation again.
referencia_no_verificada: The reference source, existence and validity still need to be checked.
referencia_ausente: Provide the exact reference, version and hash.
propuesta_no_verificada: The proposal still needs to be checked against the selection rules and by the competent authority.
material_ausente: Complete this item in the proposal.
circuito_pendiente: The authorised procedure and its evidence are required. This preparation does not establish completion.
resolucion_pendiente: The proposals retain the members. The competent authority must decide on abstentions, challenges and replacements.
campo_bases_s2: Local revision of the preparation of selection rules
campo_reglas_baremacion: Optional reference to the existing scoring rules
campo_habilitacion_por_fase: Authorisation to act and access by phase
